idea-plugin.name: Code Comment Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate SQL and HTTP comments in a collapsible outline on the right side of the editor.

Code Comment Navigator is free and open source under the MIT License. Individuals and organizations may use it for personal or commercial purposes. No purchase, subscription, or activation key is required.

Keep long database schemas, reporting queries, migration scripts, and HTTP request collections easy to navigate. Group sections by business domain and jump directly to the query or request you need.

Features

  • SQL, HTTP, and REST files: organize comment headings into six Markdown levels.
  • Navigate to a heading with a click or Enter; search headings by typing in the outline.
  • Follow the selected editor and refresh the outline after edits, without saving.
  • Expand or collapse headings, with folding state retained while editing the same file.
  • Browse SQL and HTTP Scratch files from the outline header, search by filename, drag files into folders, and create files or folders.
  • Recognize HTTP request separators and fall back to ordinary comments when no headings exist.
  • Java and Kotlin: open the existing comment navigation popup from the editor context menu.

Getting started

Open a SQL or HTTP file, then select View > Tool Windows > Comment Outline. Project files and Scratches are supported.

Use -- # Heading in SQL and // # Heading in HTTP. Add more hash characters for deeper levels. An HTTP ### Request name separator is treated as a level-two heading.

The editor context menu and Edit menu also provide the Comment Structure action.

License and support

The MIT License permits use, modification, and redistribution, including commercial use, subject to retaining the copyright and license notices. The software is provided as is, without warranty.

No fixed update schedule or support response time is promised.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.2.1

  • Expand or collapse Scratch files from their own bottom header. Click the gray current filename to search the current comment outline, with parent context and keyboard navigation.
  • Show Scratch folders and files directly without an extra Scratches root node. Use empty space below the tree to move files back to the root folder.
  • Place the Scratch file tree and search field in a resizable bottom section, keeping the comment outline visible above. Retain all destination folders while searching, so filtered files can be dragged into folders without clearing the query.

Version 1.2.0

  • Added a searchable Scratch file picker in the outline header for SQL and HTTP files, including subdirectories.
  • Added drag-and-drop file moves and an inline + form: .sql/.http creates a file, a name without an extension creates a folder.
  • Embedded the searchable file tree in the tool window and aligned the filename dropdown arrow.
  • Excluded dot-prefixed folders and their contents, such as .git and .idea, from Scratch browsing and search.
  • Added English and Chinese UI text following the IDE language, with native light and dark theme support.

Version 1.1.0

  • Added a right-side Markdown comment outline for SQL and HTTP files.
  • Added heading navigation, live refresh, and ordinary-comment fallback.
  • Fixed the navigation action registration and SQL block-comment parsing.
  • Updated compatibility to IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.
  • Released the project under the MIT License and updated documentation and contact details.
